resource.title: Resource Planning
resource.subtitle: Capacity planning analysis based on Simulink queueing simulations for DR screening.
resource.keyFindingText: AI processing throughput (3,600 images/hour) is significantly faster than human review capacity — human ophthalmologist review is the system bottleneck, not AI inference.
resource.comparisonSub: Impact of reviewer staffing on system performance under various arrival rates.
resource.slaNote: 30-minute wait time SLA (per PS 26038 human-in-the-loop requirement) is violated only in the single-reviewer peak scenario — demonstrating the need for adequate reviewer staffing at scale.
resource.vizSub: Precomputed Simulink charts showing queue length and wait time trends.
